Ladybird for Windows (unofficial port)
======================================

This is an unofficial, experimental, AI-assisted ("vibe coded") Windows port of the Ladybird web browser. It is not
made by, affiliated with, or endorsed by the Ladybird project.

Source code for this build: https://github.com/YGX77/Windows-Claude-test
Upstream Ladybird:          https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird

Ladybird itself is licensed under the 2-clause BSD license; the full text and copyright notice are in the file
LICENSE next to this one. That license, and its copyright notice, apply to the Ladybird programs in this download.

Third-party libraries
---------------------

This download also contains third-party libraries built unmodified from the vcpkg package collection
(https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg), among them Qt, Skia, FFmpeg, ICU, OpenSSL, curl, SDL, HarfBuzz, libwebp,
libjpeg-turbo, SQLite and the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime. Each of them is distributed under its own license, which
is not changed by the license of Ladybird. For example, Qt is available under the LGPL and GPL
(https://www.qt.io/licensing), and FFmpeg under the LGPL or GPL depending on how it is built.

The license and source of each library can be found in its vcpkg port, at
https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/tree/master/ports/<name>, and at the home page of the library itself.

The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs (vcruntime*.dll, msvcp*.dll, concrt140.dll, vccorlib140.dll) are redistributed
under the Microsoft Visual Studio redistribution terms.

No warranty
-----------

This software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. It is experimental and may crash or misbehave.
